intro.title: Medium side quest: A library system
intro.bodyMarkdown:
A school library lends books to members. Three classes work together:

- `Book`: a title, an author, and who has it (`borrower`, or `null`);
- `Member`: a name, and the books they have out (at most 3);
- `Library`: keeps the books and members, and lends and returns books, checking the rules.

The rules: a book can only be lent if it is in; a member can't have more than 3 books; only the borrower can return a book. Breaking a rule throws an `Error` saying why.

```text
library.lend("Dune", "Ana")    ✓
library.lend("Dune", "Ben")    ✗ Dune is already out
library.giveBack("Dune", "Ben") ✗ Ben doesn't have Dune
```

intro.title: Hard side quest: A tiny battle game
intro.bodyMarkdown:
Build the heart of a turn-based game. Every character has a name, health and a basic attack; special kinds of character attack in their own way.

- `Character`: `name`, `health` (private, never below 0), `power`; `takeDamage(n)`; getter `isAlive`; `attack(target)` does `power` damage and returns a line like `Ana hits Orc for 5`.
- `Warrior extends Character`: every third attack is a **critical**, double damage, and the line ends with ` (critical!)`.
- `Mage extends Character`: has `mana` (starts at 10); an attack costs 4 mana and does `power * 2`; without enough mana it does a basic attack.
- `battle(a, b)`: they take turns, `a` first, until one falls, returning the lines and who won.

Nothing here is random, so every battle can be checked exactly.
